articles.title: Researchers Discover OpenAI API Vulnerability That Leaks Hidden AI Reasoning Traces
articles.summary:
Researchers have disclosed a vulnerability in the OpenAI API that reveals hidden reasoning traces by exploiting conversation compaction. This technique, named “Compaction Smuggling,” bypassed existing safeguards and could allow for the extraction of valuable training material from advanced models. articles.title: HashiCorp Consul Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Bypass Authorization and Gain Elevated Privileges
articles.summary:
HashiCorp disclosed a vulnerability in consul-k8s, a cross-namespace authorization bypass that could let attackers with limited Kubernetes permissions gain elevated Consul privileges. This vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-110720 and affects component access control list (ACL) binding rules when automated system ACL management is enabled. HashiCorp published advisory HCSEC-2026-50 on October 26, 2026, and released fixes […]

articles.title: Apple Fixes Actively Exploited iOS Zero-Day Vulnerability in CoreGraphics
articles.summary:

These updates were released on October 26, 2026, and also resolve information disclosure and unauthorized camera access issues affecting the Audio and CoreMedia components. articles.summary:

The operation does not require compromising Anthropic’s infrastructure. articles.title: Hackers Abuse Magento CMS Blocks to Infect Online Stores and Evade Malware Detection
articles.summary:
Hackers are injecting JavaScript into Magento CMS blocks to maintain access to compromised storefronts while selectively hiding malicious responses from security scanners. Registered on October 6, 2026, the domain appeared on infected stores the following evening. Sixty of the 83 victims previously loaded infrastructure belonging to the same operator, including 34 infected since October 2025. […]

articles.title: Alibaba’s Qwen AI Model Attempts to Upload Files to China While Performing Cybersecurity Tasks
articles.summary:

Fortunately, a sandbox environment blocked the request. However, researchers couldn’t determine whether this behavior resulted from malicious training or accidental contamination. articles.title: DreamHost Security Incident Forces Password Resets for Email and FTP/SFTP Accounts
articles.summary:
DreamHost has implemented forced password resets for certain email and FTP/SFTP accounts following an incident that affected its File Manager and webmail services. The company restored its browser-based File Manager on October 26, 2026. However, users affected by the incident must obtain new login credentials from their account owners before they can access their accounts. […]
